text:
diane_fin: Heads-up — INV-5078 (May cycle) shows duplicated usage that appears to straddle the Apr 30 -> May 1 boundary. Customer 'BrightArc' flagged a $3,240 overcharge. Can we approve a manual credit and a usage-transfer to the correct project tag?

kai_metering: Can you paste the invoice lines and any raw usage ids?

diane_fin: Snippet (redacted ids):

```
Invoice INV-5078
Date: 2025-05-02
Line 14: usage-core prod-brightarc-2025-04-30 540,000 tokens @ $0.006 = $3,240
Line 15: usage-core shared-pool-2025-05-01 540,000 tokens @ $0.006 = $3,240  <-- duplicate of same events
Subtotal lines 14-15: $6,480
Expected: single 540k token charge $3,240
Requested adjustment: credit $3,240 and transfer usage from shared-pool to prod-brightarc project (so billing reflects correct owner)
```

billing-bot: Heuristic: cross-day double-counting detected (confidence 85%). Suggested actions: issue credit memo CM-INV-5078-TZ (amount: $3,240), create transfer ledger entry to reassign usage, open FIN-2025-321 to track reconciliation.

kai_metering: I pulled the raw events. Two ingestion records for the same request id (rid-77a3) exist: one stamped 2025-04-30T23:59:58Z and another 2025-05-01T00:00:02+01:00 (local tz). Dedupe key omitted timezone-normalization step, so the system treated them as distinct. Log snippet: 

```
{"rid":"rid-77a3","ts":"2025-04-30T23:59:58Z","project":"prod-brightarc","tokens":540000}
{"rid":"rid-77a3","ts":"2025-05-01T00:00:02+01:00","project":"shared-pool","tokens":540000}
```

leo_engineering: Confirming — root cause is missing canonicalization of timestamp to UTC before computing ingestion dedupe hash. Also the pipeline applied a project-mapping step after dedupe which caused the different project tag. I'll open a patch to normalize timestamps earlier and move project-mapping before dedupe. PR #761. Adding alert when same rid appears in multiple day buckets.

sophia_am: BrightArc is upset because finance team at their company reconciles by project tag. They asked for a corrected invoice and a note for auditors. Prefer we perform usage-transfer rather than a straight refund so their internal accounting stays intact.

diane_fin: Proposed remediation: 1) Issue credit memo CM-5078-TZ for $3,240 and immediately post to customer account (pending approval) 2) Create ledger transfer entry TX-2025-084 to move the 540k tokens charge from shared-pool to prod-brightarc 3) Generate corrected invoice INV-5078-CORR with transferred usage and attach to customer portal 4) Engineering to deploy dedupe fix and add monitor. Approve?

billing-bot: Draft credit memo CM-5078-TZ created (amount: $3,240). Draft transfer TX-2025-084 queued. Ticket FIN-2025-321 opened.

leo_engineering: I'll run a backfill to identify any other rid collisions in the 48-hour window around the timezone boundary and list affected invoices. Expect report in 4 hours.

sophia_am: I support transfer approach. Will draft partner-facing message: "We discovered an internal metering edge case around timezone normalization that duplicated usage across project tags. We've transferred the charge to the correct project and issued a corrective invoice and credit memo for your records. Apologies for the confusion; engineering deployed a fix and we'll audit for similar cases." Will paste into FIN-2025-321 for sign-off.

diane_fin: Approving manual credit & transfer now. Finance will post CM-5078-TZ and create corrected invoice. Payment action: no external refund needed if transfer resolves customer's ledger; if customer already paid and requests cash refund, we'll process ACH refund ref ACH-7751 on request.

billing-bot: Action items: finance post credit & corrected invoice, ops schedule backfill, eng deploy dedupe fix, account manager send comms.

leo_engineering: Backfill report: found 3 additional rids with same pattern affecting invoices INV-5080 and INV-5083. I'll include those in FIN-2025-321 for batch adjustment.

sophia_am: Noted — I'll coordinate with customers and offer credit memos or transfers as preferred.

diane_fin: Closing loop for INV-5078: CM-5078-TZ posted, INV-5078-CORR uploaded, TX-2025-084 applied in ledger, FIN-2025-321 updated with next steps for remaining invoices. Reopen if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
